messages:
alex: evening handoff — taking off at 18:30 PT. quick bullets:
- Deploy: rolled out v3.2.1 to hosted yesterday at 10:14; no errors in logs but saw a small spike in tail latency on Tue afternoon (p95 ~ 420ms). please monitor the latency dashboard for the next 3 hours.
- Risk: cache eviction changed to aggressive during yesterday's prefcache tuning; prefetch hit-rate dropped to ~32% for short requests. i reverted one node to the previous config but keep an eye on hit-rate.
- Action items: (1) if p95 > 400ms for > 5m, flip feature flag to small-batch mode (flag: pref:window=3). (2) if error rate > 0.5% for 10m, start rolling restart of cache nodes: `./scripts/rolling-restart.sh cache -n 3`.
- PRs: PTAL on #2728 (batching opt) — needs eng-runtime review. #2741 (healthcheck backoff) is merged and deployed.
- Observability: traces show intermittent 503s on /v1/generate tied to backend pool exhaustion; correlation with long-prompt traffic.

priya: thanks — noted. i'll watch latency for the next 2 hours. if p95 > 450 i'll flip small-batch and post an update.

matt: added a short note to the canary dashboard about a minor tokenizer perf regression for en-us (affects long prompts). not blocking but could reduce throughput.

sarah: quick q — what's the exact curl to add to pager checks for the health endpoint?

alex: healthcheck command to use:
``
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}s" -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" https://hosted.redwood/v1/health
```
should return 200 and time_total < 0.25s.

oncall-bot: scheduled: rolling restart of cache pool `cache-prod-b` at 02:00 UTC tomorrow (maintenance window) — ETA ~20m :wrench:.

priya: noted on the scheduled restart. i'll avoid manual restarts unless we hit the thresholds.

matt: FYI i left a comment on PR #2728 about a fallback for short-seq workloads. will follow up in the morning.

sarah: tagged eng-ml in the tokenizer note so they can triage first thing. @anya — can you take a quick look on your morning? :wave:

alex: final notes: my phone will be offline after 19:00 PT. if anything escalates, page as usual. follow-up owners:
- priya: monitor latency + flip small-batch if needed
- matt: follow PR #2728 + canary perf
- sarah: add healthcheck to pager checks

thanks all, handing off. :thumbsup:
